blocks.html:
Character Progression Systems

AION 2 layers well over a dozen progression systems on top of your base class. The cards below are listed roughly in unlock order, from the skills you touch at level 1 through to endgame Combat Power grinding, so you can read top to bottom as a rough roadmap.

Global launches October 5, 2026, and most numbers here come from the KR/TW live client, so treat exact thresholds as subject to change.

blocks.title: Mastery Skills and Specialization
blocks.headExtrasHtml: Available from lvl 1, breakpoints at 8, 12, 16 confirmed marketing
blocks.bodyHtml:
Mastery Skills level automatically; spend Skill Points on your core 3-4 rotation abilities.

What it is

Mastery Skills are your core class abilities. They are learned automatically as you hit level requirements. expcarry, date unknown1

Every level-up grants Skill Points, which you spend to raise a Mastery Skill up to a base cap of 10. YouTube, date unknown2 LDCloud, date unknown3

How it works

  • Skill Points can be refunded for a small Kinah fee, so early experimentation is safe Fextralife, date unknown4.
  • Daevanion board and gear effects can push a skill's effective level to 12 or 16, past the base cap of 10 Fextralife, date unknown5.
  • At skill breakpoints of level 8, 12, and 16, you can pick up to 3 additional chosen effects, called Specialization Fextralife, date unknown6 oslink, date unknown7.
  • Extra Skill Points come from Empyrean Traces, world collectibles turned in at a Monolith for Wisdom Stones, an item that grants Skill Points on use. Fextralife, date unknown8

    A separate guide calls the same collectible simply "Feathers" turned in at city Monoliths. Differ, date unknown9

Korean class-board guides from 2026 routinely talk about pushing core skills to skill level 20, and some to 25, above the 8/12/16 breakpoints described here. That ceiling is reached with Daevanion, Stigma and Arcana bonuses stacked on the base cap, and no single source states the current maximum, so treat the top breakpoint as KR-era and unverified for global kr-era inven, 2026-0210 dcinside, 202611. The per-class Leveling build cards give the skill-level targets those guides use.
Naming is inconsistent between sources: "Empyrean Traces"/"Wisdom Stones" versus "Feathers" are likely different translations of the same KR-era item, so treat the exact item names as contested.

Beginner priority

Beginner priority: put points into your main damage chain, a self-heal or HP recovery skill, and anything usable while moving, then push your rotation's core 3-4 abilities past the 8/12/16 breakpoints expcarry, date unknown12.

Common mistake

Common mistake: spreading Skill Points thin across many skills instead of concentrating on your rotation's core abilities.
blocks.tags: mastery skills specialization skill points wisdom stones empyrean traces

blocks.title: Stigma System
blocks.headExtrasHtml: First slot unlocks lvl 23 contested marketing
blocks.bodyHtml:
Stigmas add build-defining abilities; sources disagree on exactly which levels unlock which slots.

What it is

Stigmas are equippable skill-enhancement stones that add build-defining abilities on top of your class kit. expcarry, date unknown1 They consume a separate currency, Stigma Shards, rather than normal Skill Points. expcarry, date unknown2

Unlock and cost

  • One detailed source says the first Stigma slot unlocks at level 23, with two more normal slots at 30 and 40, two Greater Stigma slots at 45 and 50, and a Major Stigma slot at 55 Aion Nova, date unknown3 Differ, date unknown4.
  • A second source instead says Stigmas unlock at level 23 with up to four equipped at once, which conflicts with the 23/30/40/45/50/55 breakdown above aion2hub, date unknown5.
  • Level 45 is confirmed to unlock two Greater Stigma slots via a group quest, "The Shattered Stigma" for Elyos or "The Shulak's Stigma" for Asmodians Differ, date unknown6.
  • KR-era content raised the Stigma level cap from 20 to 25, requiring a higher-tier Shard above level 20; this is explicitly flagged as KR-only and unconfirmed for global expcarry, date unknown7 kr-era.

Beginner priority

Beginner priority: pick a single PvE rotation and fund the Stigmas that fill actual gaps in it, upgrading your most-used Stigma first rather than spreading Shards across every Stigma you own expcarry, date unknown8 Overgear, date unknown9.

Common mistake

Common mistake: building a PvP Stigma set before you have a stable PvE rotation, which wastes scarce Shards.
blocks.tags: stigma shards skill enhancement pvp pve rotation

blocks.title: Daevanion Board
blocks.headExtrasHtml: First board unlocks lvl 12 confirmed
blocks.bodyHtml:
Six Daevanion Boards unlock through level 45 and add permanent combat stats separate from gear.

What it is

A permanent node-board progression system, separate from gear, that raises combat stats and effective skill levels. Overgear, date unknown1 aion2hub, date unknown2

Unlock and cost

  • The first board unlocks at level 12; one detailed source states there are 6 total boards unlocking progressively, with the last two arriving at level 45 Fextralife, date unknown3 Talentbuilds, date unknown4.
  • Daevanion Points unlock nodes; Points and Daevanion Crystals both come from regional quests, Sealed Dungeons, Strongholds, achievements, and exploration Overgear, date unknown5 expcarry, date unknown6 Differ, date unknown7.
  • The KR client can reset a whole board or individual nodes, with a single-node reset costing 500 Kinah in Korea. expcarry, date unknown8 kr-era, self-flagged as provisional

    A node cannot be removed while another already-acquired node depends on it. The source explicitly flags that Global's final reset costs, caps, and terminology may differ from what shipped in Korea.

    Separately, Korean community discussion claims a recent patch "significantly reduced" reset costs for both skills and Daevanion nodes, without giving a before/after number, consistent with but not independent confirmation of the 500 Kinah figure. single source, vague liveissue.kr, date unknown9

How it works

  • Gold/orange nodes are passive stat boosts, blue nodes amplify active skills, and green nodes optimize existing passives like resource regen, per one summary. expcarry, date unknown10

    A second source describes essentially the same split as "skill nodes" and "stat nodes" without the color breakdown, a likely simplification rather than a contradiction.

  • The board is cited as a source of 500+ "passive" Combat Power that does not require gear swapping, earned by clearing hidden question-mark dungeons, Sealed Dungeons, and Strongholds u4n, date unknown11.

Beginner priority

Beginner priority: trace the cheapest path to skill/stat nodes that support one specific loadout, comparing full routes by total point cost rather than grabbing every nearby node purely for Combat Power expcarry, date unknown12.

Common mistake

Common mistake: neglecting the board while rushing the main story; it's a significant permanent power source that's easy to overlook Overgear, date unknown13.
No official AION 2 global skill or stigma-name glossary has been published pre-launch. The official global-facing material found only confirms the roster of 8 launch classes plus an unconfirmed 9th (Brawler, seen in KR/TW) and a Launch Scale Test running September 17-18, 2026 single source, marketing-aggregator, not the official site itself mmoculture, 2026-0714. All node and skill names used on this page are fan translations from community guides, not official localizations, unless otherwise noted.
blocks.tags: daevanion board nodes points crystals progression

blocks.title: Arcana
blocks.headExtrasHtml: Obtained mainly from Transcendence dungeons single source marketing
blocks.bodyHtml:
Arcana cards add item level, stats, and set bonuses; fill every slot rather than chasing perfect rarity.

What it is

A card-based system that adds Item Level, combat stats, set bonuses, and effective skill levels all at once. expcarry, date unknown1

  • Original slot types are Chalice, Parchment, Compass, Bell, and Mirror; later content reportedly added Scales, Key, Hourglass, Dice, and Lantern, for up to nine slots total. expcarry, date unknown2 Vortex Gaming, date unknown3

    More precisely, the card-slot rollout came in generations: the original five (Chalice, Parchment, Compass, Bell, Mirror), Scales added in "Season 2," and Key, Hourglass, Dice, and Lantern added in "Chapter 1." single source expcarry, date unknown4

  • Rarity tiers cited are Common (about +20 item level), Rare (+40), Epic (+60), and Unique (+80), affecting a card's overall item-level contribution. expcarry, date unknown5

    A separate source uses "green 40, blue 60, unique 80" for the same slots, suggesting a rarity-name translation mismatch between sources.

How it works

  • Cards come primarily from Transcendence dungeons tied to specific slots, sets, and crystal families, expcarry, date unknown6 Overgear, date unknown7 plus crafting/synthesis, extraction from unwanted cards, and events.

    The guidance is to pick a dungeon for its Arcana output rather than for its difficulty stage alone. single source expcarry, date unknown8

  • Cards gain experience from Training Arcana consumables (Lesser 200 EXP, Intermediate 600, Superior 1,500, Ultimate 3,000) or by feeding in other cards. expcarry, date unknown9

    Skill-level bonuses stack with Stigma and Daevanion bonuses toward the same 16-20 breakpoints. Equipping five different cards is separately said to "significantly increase" skill levels and Combat Power. aion2hub, date unknown10

  • Targeted cards can also be crafted directly using tiered crystals, Mysterious, Harmonious, Noble, or Splendent Noble depending on card generation, plus Kinah single source, detailed expcarry, date unknown11.

Beginner priority

Beginner priority: fill every slot with something usable rather than waiting for a perfect Unique card, protect skill breakpoints and set bonuses over raw item level, save Training Arcana for cards you plan to keep, and farm the Transcendence dungeon that matches the slot or crystal family you actually need expcarry, date unknown12.

Common mistake

Common mistake: leaving slots empty, farming the wrong dungeon for prestige, over-enhancing filler cards, or destroying a card before confirming its replacement is actually equipped expcarry, date unknown13.
Flag: this progression system, dungeon-gated drops, tiered EXP materials, and crystal crafting, is exactly the kind of thing that could change materially for global launch, so treat every figure above as KR-era kr-era. No official global skill-name glossary exists either, so card-to-skill assignments quoted elsewhere on this page are fan translations, not confirmed localizations mmoculture, 2026-0714.
blocks.tags: arcana cards item level transcendence set effects

blocks.title: Equipment Grades and Enhancement
blocks.headExtrasHtml: Gear from questing, loot, and the Broker contested marketing
blocks.bodyHtml:
Gear grade names vary by source; enhance evenly across slots before pushing any one piece high.

What it is

NCSoft's own patch notes reportedly confirm at least Heroic and Unique grades, with Unique higher. exitlag, date unknown1

Community sources also describe a wider tier list, Rare from standard dungeons, Unique from Hard Mode, Legendary from Nightmare/Abyss content, alongside a separate Green/Blue/Purple/Gold color scheme used for Pantheon items, so grade naming is not fully consistent across sources.

How it works

  • Enhance Stones raise a gear piece's level; enchanting adds PvE Attack/Defense on PvE gear or PvP Attack/Defense on PvP gear depending on item type exitlag, date unknown2.
  • Failing an enchant does not destroy the item, and extracting a previously-enhanced item refunds 100% of the Enhance Stones spent into it exitlag, date unknown3 Fextralife, date unknown4.
  • Suggested safe breakpoints to stop and bank Kinah: +3-5, +8 ("damage smoothing", especially for weapons), +10 (feels properly progressed), +12 (controlled risk on good gear), and +15 (only for long-term keeper gear) BoostRoom, date unknown5.
  • Mana Stones socket into gear for stats like Crit Rate or Speed, helping gear "scale into late-game without major farming" alongside Soul Codexes. u4n, date unknown6 Fextralife, date unknown7

    A separate single source describes an "engraving" mechanic where one attempt rerolls every socket, uncorroborated elsewhere.

  • Gear comes from questing, world/dungeon loot, and the player marketplace or Broker Fextralife, date unknown8.

Beginner priority

Beginner priority: enhance your weapon first since it gives the single biggest damage boost, then survivability armor, then remaining armor, then accessories last BoostRoom, date unknown9 Overgear, date unknown10.

Common mistake

Avoid: pushing one piece to a high, risky enhancement level before your other slots have reached a low safe tier.
blocks.tags: equipment grades enhancement enchanting sockets weapon

blocks.title: Manastones and Theostones
blocks.headExtrasHtml: Socketed into gear and weapons confirmed
blocks.bodyHtml:
Mana Stones and Theostones are socketed gems and weapon procs, slot them in as they drop.

What it is

Mana Stones are AION 2's socketed stat gems, found via dungeons, rewards, or crafting. u4n, date unknown1 Fextralife, date unknown2 Theostones are the weapon proc-stone equivalent of classic AION's Godstones.

How it works

  • Theostones socket into a weapon's dedicated slot and grant a chance-on-hit proc effect such as damage or a debuff; one effect per weapon, and identical Theostones do not stack aion2.online, date unknown3.
  • A community database lists 153 known Theostones, corroborated across three independent sources aion2.online, date unknown4 aion2hub, date unknown5.

Beginner priority

Beginner priority: treat Mana Stones and Theostones as gradual scaling tools you slot in as they drop, rather than something to farm dedicated runs for early on.
blocks.tags: manastones theostones godstone sockets weapon proc

blocks.title: Soul Binding
blocks.headExtrasHtml: Grows once bound, per one source single source
blocks.bodyHtml:
One uncorroborated source says bound gear gains a growing secondary stat; bind and use gear normally.

What it is

Described by one fan-run compiled wiki as a secondary stat block on gear that "only grows once you bind it." kodex.yavuz, date unknown1 This is likely analogous to classic AION's soul-binding-on-equip mechanic but with an added stat-growth twist here.

Not corroborated by any other source found; treat the whole mechanic as single-source and uncertain until confirmed elsewhere.

Beginner priority

Beginner priority: bind and use gear normally, since even the single source describing this doesn't suggest a reason to delay binding.
blocks.tags: soul binding gear stat growth uncertain

blocks.title: Pantheon
blocks.headExtrasHtml: Domains cap at 200 points each single source cluster marketing
blocks.bodyHtml:
Pantheon is an unconfirmed passive-stat system, slot pieces in opportunistically, don't farm it dedicated.

What it is

An "often overlooked" permanent passive-stat system built from Statues, Colossi, and "Artwork"/frameworks; placing a Colossus into a Pantheon slot grants points toward one of several "deity domains," each capping at 200 points before converting into flat combat stats. Vortex Gaming, date unknown1 rsnxt, date unknown2

How it works

  • Item rarity (Green to Blue to Purple to Gold) determines each piece's bonus strength, with Green giving 40 stat points and Blue 60 in one cited example.
  • Named domains include Wisdom (strike chance/final damage), Freedom (accuracy/evasion), and Death (critical hit chance) Vortex Gaming, date unknown3.
This system rests on a small cluster of corroborating community sources, mostly one aggregator plus a boosting site, with no wiki or database confirmation found. Treat the whole Pantheon system as not independently confirmed, though the name itself appears consistently.

Beginner priority

Beginner priority: treat Pantheon pieces as passive value you slot in opportunistically rather than a system worth dedicated farming until it's better confirmed for global.
blocks.tags: pantheon statues colossi artwork passive stats

blocks.title: Titles, Achievements, and Collections
blocks.headExtrasHtml: Title slots reported around lvl 30 contested
blocks.bodyHtml:
Achievements and titles come from normal play, don't farm them as a separate track.

What it is

Achievements grant Achievement Points and rewards, and completing them ties into Daevanion Point/Crystal income. Differ, date unknown1

How it works

  • One database lists 1,307 achievements, while a differing count elsewhere cites 4,225 named achievements across grades, categories, and factions, of which 2,685 grant rewards; likely different snapshots or counting methods aion2hub, date unknown2.
  • Titles: one source counts 1,472 total titles with 844 granting stat bonuses, earned via PvP rank, Arena tiers, boss kills, monster-hunting milestones, server-first accomplishments, and mini-game/event wins. aion2hub, date unknown3

    Stat titles grant things like PvP Attack, PvP Accuracy, HP, Defense, Combat/Move Speed, or Critical Hit; some titles are purely cosmetic.

  • A separate source states you can have 3 active title effects at once across Offensive/Defensive/Other categories, unlocking around level 30; this slot count and level could not be cross-confirmed, treat as single-source.
  • An Appearance Collection (wardrobe) exists; collecting roughly 700 appearances grants combat speed and cooldown reduction as a milestone bonus. Vortex Gaming, date unknown4

    Cash-shop cosmetics do not count toward this bonus, though they do count for achievements.

Beginner priority

Beginner priority: don't farm titles or achievements as a separate track early; treat them as a byproduct of normal questing and dungeon clears, and periodically check the achievement panel for cheap stat titles you already qualify for.
blocks.tags: titles achievements collections codex wardrobe

blocks.title: Pets and Mounts
blocks.headExtrasHtml: 200+ pets collectible confirmed
blocks.bodyHtml:
Pets double as mounts, farm 10 "souls" of a monster to unlock each one.

What it is

Pets and mounts are the same system in AION 2: any pet you own can also be ridden as a mount. u4n, date unknown1 Fextralife, date unknown2 Over 200 pets are collectible. BoostRoom, date unknown3

How it works

  • The main method is farming 10 "souls" of almost any monster to unlock it as a pet/mount; souls also drop from the Shugo Shop and the Black Cloud Merchant, and rare mounts can come from Hidden Cubes Fextralife, date unknown4.
  • The in-game Pets menu has a "Source" tab showing exactly where a given soul drops.

Beginner priority

Beginner priority: don't ignore world mobs while leveling, many double as free future mounts once you've collected 10 souls; check the Source tab before grinding blindly for a specific pet.
blocks.tags: pets mounts souls collection

blocks.title: Wings and Flight
blocks.headExtrasHtml: Earned around lvl 10 (unverified) confirmed
blocks.bodyHtml:
Flight is a real combat mechanic, not cosmetic; wings and mounts are complementary tools.

What it is

Flight is a core combat and traversal mechanic, not just cosmetic transportation; some Abyss boss mechanics reportedly require flight to execute correctly. TheGamer, date unknown1 u4n, date unknown2

Unlock and cost

  • Wings are not available from level 1; one single, unverified source gives a rough unlock around level 10.

How it works

  • Wings have a "flight power" stat acting as airborne stamina; upgrading a wing raises max flight power via a physics-based "Glide Gauge" rather than a rigid timer TheGamer, date unknown3 u4n, date unknown4.
  • Only wings earned through gameplay grant flight power; purchased cosmetic wing skins sit in a separate skin slot layered over your earned wings and provide no flight benefit TheGamer, date unknown5.
  • Higher-quality wings also add flat Attack/Defense/HP and can grant movement speed or special combat effects.

Beginner priority

Beginner priority: use mounts as your short-range sprint tool and wings/gliding as your long-range terrain-skip tool, they're complementary, not redundant. Manage your Glide Gauge deliberately, since running out mid-air just drops you.
blocks.tags: wings flight glide gauge flight power

blocks.title: Legion
blocks.headExtrasHtml: Up to 128 members contested marketing
blocks.bodyHtml:
Legions cap at 128 members and offer organization and group access; the level, hall and buff perks below are disputed.

What it is

AION 2's guild system, capped at up to 128 members per Legion, used for PvE, PvP, crafting, and social access. exitlag, date unknown1 6Sword, date unknown2 Legion perks are mostly about organization and access to reliable groups rather than direct stat buffs. mmoexp, date unknown3

How it works

  • Legion Hall unlocks at Legion level 5, costs 1,000,000 Kinah to rent, and houses cooking, alchemy, jewelcrafting, armorsmithing, and blacksmithing merchants/workbenches together, the real convenience benefit mmoexp, date unknown4.
  • Legion Coin is earned for active contribution and spent on Legion-exclusive skins, uniforms, masks, mounts, and wings at specialized merchants u4n, date unknown5.
  • Legion levels beyond 5 raise the member cap and unlock member access to purchase or use new Abyss weapons and armor mmoexp, date unknown6.
Disputed: the Legion level, Legion Hall unlock and Abyss-gear perks above come from a single boosting-adjacent source. Three independent sources say Legions have no levels, warehouse or mechanical buffs, and a developer statement from February 2026 agrees. See the "Legion: Rank Structure and the Warehouse/Buff Controversy" card further down this page.

Beginner priority

Beginner priority: join an active Legion early for group content access and Legion Hall crafting convenience; don't expect membership itself to be a large stat boost.
blocks.tags: legion guild hall coin crafting

blocks.title: Companions / Summoned Spirits
blocks.headExtrasHtml: Class kit feature, not universal single source
blocks.bodyHtml:
There's no universal companion system, only the Spiritmaster's four elemental summon spirits.

What it is

There is no evidence of a general, class-agnostic "companion" or "summon" progression system in AION 2.

The only summon-type mechanic found is class-specific to the Spiritmaster, which channels four elemental spirits (Fire, Water, Wind, Earth) as combat pets/turrets with independent attack capability, used to chain skill activations for DPS. Fextralife, date unknown1 mmoexp, date unknown2

Treat "Companions" as not a universal system; it is a Spiritmaster kit feature, not something every character has.
blocks.tags: companions summons spiritmaster class specific

blocks.title: Stats That Matter
blocks.headExtrasHtml: PvE and PvP stats are fully separate single source marketing
blocks.bodyHtml:
PvE and PvP stats are fully separate pools; build your PvE set first and ignore PvP caps for now.

What it is

Accuracy governs the chance to land an attack and, per one source, also affects crit chance; Precision is a hybrid stat raising both Accuracy and Crit chance. u4n, date unknown1

How it works

  • PvE Attack/Defense only comes from PvE gear and only affects damage to monsters; PvP Attack/Defense only comes from PvP gear and only affects damage to other players exitlag, date unknown2.
  • One source states endgame PvE targets are roughly Accuracy 2350 and Critical Hit 2600-2700 depending on synergy/buffs. u4n, date unknown3

    The Combat Power formula itself stops rewarding further Accuracy above 1700 or Crit above 80%, making stacking past those levels inefficient for Combat Power purposes.

  • Because burst damage is high (one source claims an Assassin can deal about 80% of a target's HP in one combo), the recommended early PvP stat order is HP, crit resistance, mitigation, then PvP Defense. BoostRoom, date unknown4

    PvP Attack is added only once survival is established.

Beginner priority

Beginner priority: build one PvE stat set first and don't chase PvP stat caps until you're actually PvPing regularly.
blocks.tags: stats accuracy crit attack pve pvp split

blocks.title: Combat Power ("Atul") and Item Level
blocks.headExtrasHtml: Item Level gates content; CP is an aggregate score single source marketing
blocks.bodyHtml:
Item Level gates content access; Combat Power is a separate aggregate score, raise both from cheap broad sources first.

What it is

There appear to be two related but distinct numbers: Item Level, which gates access to activities such as Transcendence content around 900-2700+ tiers, and Combat Power or "Atul Score," an aggregate power estimate used for matchmaking/ranking-style comparisons. Fextralife, date unknown1 u4n, date unknown2

The "Atul" naming is single-source and could be a translation artifact; treat with caution.

How it works

  • Fastest ways to raise Combat Power, per multiple sources:
    • Even gear enhancement across all slots up to a low safe tier before pushing any one piece further
    • Filling Daevanion board nodes (500+ passive CP cited)
    • Collecting/upgrading Arcana cards (400+ CP cited)
    • Raising Accuracy toward roughly 1200+ via Ariel, wings, magic stones, and the Sanctuary Bracelet
    • Completing early permanent items like the Noble Belt and Revelation Amulet Vortex Gaming, date unknown3 u4n, date unknown4
  • Rushing the Yellow (Main Story) quest line is also cited as a fast way to raise base stats and thus CP u4n, date unknown5.

Beginner priority

Beginner priority: chase the cheap, broad CP sources first (Daevanion nodes, Arcana, main story) before grinding for marginal gear enhancement gains.
blocks.tags: combat power item level atul score cp

blocks.title: Transcendence and Odyle Energy
blocks.headExtrasHtml: Entry tickets removed as of Jul 2026 patch confirmed kr-era
blocks.bodyHtml:
Odyle Energy opens reward cubes after a clear, not dungeon entry, and it's shared across normal and Transcendence runs.

What it is

Transcendence is AION 2's endgame progression/ranking layer, class-ranked, fed by specific dungeons such as "Phantom Corridor" with up to 4 escalating difficulty levels that raise the minimum entry Combat Power and monster strength; main rewards are Arcana cards plus Breakthrough Stone Fragments and Stigma Shard Fragments (single source, KR-era).

How it works

  • As of a July 1, 2026 patch, entry tickets for Expedition and Transcendence dungeons were removed; instead, Odyle Energy is spent only to open the reward cube after clearing a run. aion2hub, 2026-071 u4n, date unknown2

    A normal boss cube costs 40 energy and Hard difficulty costs 60, and normal/Transcendence dungeons draw from the same shared energy pool.

  • One source states Transcendence content becomes available around gear score ~1650, unverified elsewhere kodex.yavuz, date unknown3.
  • No evidence was found of a traditional "class advancement" or ascension tier in AION 2.

    What exists instead is Transcendence dungeons plus "Awakening Battles," timed solo encounters with extra objectives and temporary combat bonuses, a separate activity track from Episode/Region/Mission content (single source, could not verify further).

Beginner priority

Beginner priority: entry itself isn't gated by energy, so you can scout Transcendence dungeons early, but budget your Odyle Energy between normal and Transcendence content since they share one pool.
blocks.tags: transcendence odyle energy dungeons endgame

blocks.title: Crafting, Gathering, and Cooking
blocks.headExtrasHtml: Five professions, gathering feeds all of them confirmed marketing
blocks.bodyHtml:
Five crafting professions share one gathering skill; pick one or two rather than spreading thin.

What it is

Five primary crafting professions are cited: Blacksmithing, Armor Smithing, Handicrafting, Alchemy, and Cooking. exitlag, date unknown1 expcarry, date unknown2 Cooking produces food/drink buffs used before dungeons and PvP.

How it works

  • Gathering is done via an "Essence Extraction" skill/action used to mine ore, gather herbs, or cut wood, feeding all five crafting lines.
  • No evidence found of a dedicated dyeing system; classic AION had player-dye mechanics, so its absence here is flagged as unverified rather than confirmed absent.

Beginner priority

Beginner priority: pick one or two gathering skills that match your intended crafting profession rather than spreading thin, and use the Legion Hall once available (Legion level 5) to access all five crafting stations in one place mmoexp, date unknown3.
blocks.tags: crafting gathering cooking professions essence extraction

blocks.title: Currencies
blocks.headExtrasHtml: Kinah is the only Broker currency confirmed marketing
blocks.bodyHtml:
Kinah is the only Broker currency; everything else is earned and spent within its own system.

A quick reference for every currency mentioned across the systems above. u4n, date unknown1

CurrencyEarned fromSpent onSrc
KinahQuests, monster kills, dungeons, vendor salesRepairs, soul-binding, crafting materials, teleports, gear enhancement, the only currency usable on the Brokeru4n, date unknown
QunaReal-money purchase; tradeable for Kinah via Currency ExchangeCosmetics, weapon/mount/wing skins, Battle Pass premium tiersu4n, date unknown
Abyss PointsDaily/weekly PvP-zone questsPresumed Abyss-specific gear/items, not independently confirmedFextralife-derived, single source
Legion CoinActive Legion contributionLegion-exclusive cosmetics, mounts, wingsu4n, date unknown
Daevanion CrystalsQuests, dungeons, achievementsUnlocking Daevanion board nodesexpcarry, date unknown
Wisdom StonesExchanging Empyrean Traces/Feathers at a MonolithGrants Skill Points on useFextralife, date unknown
Stigma ShardsNot detailed in sourcesLeveling Stigma Skills; higher-tier Shards for KR levels 21-25expcarry, date unknown
Enhance StonesNot detailed in sourcesRaising gear enhancement levelexitlag, date unknown
Centuryroot TokenNot detailed in sourcesShugo Festival seasonal shop; purpose beyond that unverifiedFextralife-derived, single source
Odyle Energy / Grace of OdylePassive regen, plus other sources detailed in the dungeons guideOpening reward cubes after Expedition/Transcendence/Sanctuary dungeon clearsaion2hub, 2026-07
No evidence was found of a separate generic "gems" currency distinct from the above; treat "gems" as not confirmed to exist as a distinct AION 2 currency.
blocks.tags: currencies kinah quna abyss points daevanion crystals

blocks.html:
More systems worth knowing

Smaller systems that sit outside the core progression cards but are still worth knowing about. Most of the other systems players ask about are covered on other pages of this guide.

Legion mechanical perks are contested (three independent sources say levels, warehouse and buffs do not exist), and several candidate systems were not found in any AION 2-specific source. The full coverage table is the last card below.

blocks.title: Character Creation and Customization
blocks.headExtrasHtml: Runs right after the opening tutorial, before level 1 confirmed official
blocks.bodyHtml:
Character creation runs before level 1 with 200+ sliders and presets, but changing your look later needs an unclear cash-shop item.

What it is

Character creation runs after the opening combat tutorial and story introduction, covering body type, face, hair, and body-shape sliders plus ready-made presets NCSoft official, 2025-11-161.

NCSoft's own figure is "more than 200 customization options" spanning body shape, skin tone, eye color, and muscle definition NCSoft official, 2025-11-162.

How it works

  • Four sections: body type, face, hair and makeup, and body shape Fextralife, date unknown3 timesaver.gg, date unknown4
    • Body type: masculine frames lean armor-like, feminine frames lean dresses/skirts/heels.
    • Face: eyebrows, eyes, iris, nose, lips.
    • Hair and makeup: available regardless of body type.
    • Body shape: height, limb proportions, muscularity, regional thickness.
  • Ready-made presets are organized by race, gender, and role so you can skip detailed sculpting timesaver.gg, date unknown5
  • Faction, class, and race are treated as permanent, with no swap service announced for global as of 2026-09-12 timesaver.gg, date unknown6

Once creation is finished, you cannot change your physical appearance without "a special kind of currency," per the community wiki, which does not name it Fextralife, date unknown7.

A second source frames this as "likely possible through a cash-shop restyle item" but says NCSoft has not published a specific item, currency, or global price single source, speculative timesaver.gg, date unknown8.

Beginner priority

Beginner priority: use a preset close to what you want rather than free-sculpting from scratch if you won't spend real time on it, since changing your look later needs a currency or item that isn't clearly defined yet for global.

Watch out

Avoid: assuming you can freely re-roll your face later the way some other MMOs allow. Budget your creation-screen time up front.

blocks.title: Housing
blocks.headExtrasHtml: Not yet live on KR/TW as of 2026-09-12 single source kr-era, unreleased
blocks.bodyHtml:
Player housing is confirmed and in development, but not live yet on KR/TW and not guaranteed for global day one.

What it is

A confirmed, in-development player housing system with exterior decoration (fences, statues, decorations) and interior furniture placement mmoexp, 2026-07-281.

Pets and mounts are shown living inside and around houses, consistent with AION 2's unified pet/mount system mmoexp, 2026-07-282.

How it works

  • Status as of 2026-07-28: "actively in development." mmoexp, 2026-07-283
    • Expected on KR/TW "within the next few months as part of early chapter updates."
    • Global housing is expected "at or shortly after" the October 5, 2026 worldwide release. NCSoft has not confirmed exact dates, unlock requirements, or costs.
  • Until housing ships, the Pantheon system already gives a private space to place "trophies and artwork" for stat bonuses, but without free-form furniture placement, per the same article

Beginner priority

Beginner priority: don't hold back on Pantheon investment while waiting for housing, they're described as separate systems, and Pantheon is confirmed live now while housing is not.

Watch out

Avoid: assuming housing is available at global launch day one. Treat it as likely but not confirmed for day one.
blocks.tags: housing player house decoration furniture upcoming

blocks.title: Accessories: Class Runes, Belts, and Amulets
blocks.titleEn: Accessories: Class Runes, Belts, and Amulets
blocks.headExtrasHtml: Unlock gate reported but not confirmed confirmed kr-era
blocks.bodyHtml:
Two good Runes are worth about 80 item levels, but stop enhancing at +1, a failed +2 attempt can break the rune.

What it is

A dedicated accessory slot type distinct from Manastones, Theostones, and Arcana cards. Named examples include Clash Rune and Devotion Rune Fextralife, date unknown1.

Runes are classed as accessories, obtained through quest completion, exploration, enemy drops, crafting, and merchant purchase, same as other accessory gear Fextralife, date unknown2.

How it works

  • Equipping two good runes is worth roughly 80 item levels, corroborated by two independent sources with nearly identical wording HackQuest/mmoexp, date unknown3 kodex.yavuz, date unknown4
  • Enhancement warning: stop rune enhancement at +1. From +2 onward, a failed attempt can break the rune entirely single source kodex.yavuz, date unknown5
  • A dedicated video guide titled "How to Unlock the Rune Accessory Slot" implies runes aren't available from level 1 and need a specific quest or milestone; the exact requirement is unconfirmed single source, title only YouTube, date unknown6
  • This guide's Combat Power card already names the Noble Belt and Revelation Amulet as early permanent item-level gains. No further independent detail on Belts or Amulets as their own mechanical system was found beyond being accessory gear slots.

Beginner priority

Beginner priority: treat the Rune slot as a big, cheap power spike once unlocked, two decent runes are worth roughly a full enhancement tier's worth of item level.

Watch out

Avoid: pushing rune enhancement past +1 before confirming whether global carries the same break-on-fail risk as KR.
blocks.tags: accessories runes belts amulets item level enhancement

blocks.title: Transfer Crafting
blocks.headExtrasHtml: Unconfirmed beyond a single source single source kr-era
blocks.bodyHtml:
One source describes a crafting process that carries enhancement progress into an upgraded item, but it's unconfirmed elsewhere.

What it is

A crafting process, distinct from normal Enhance Stone enchanting, that lets a player carry a gear piece's enhancement level, amplification, and Soul Binding progress forward into its next-tier upgrade rather than starting over kodex.yavuz, date unknown1.

How it works

  • The same source states the process is "guaranteed to succeed," unlike normal enhancement rolls, and that the resulting upgraded item becomes Soul Bound to the crafter as part of the transfer.
Not corroborated by any second source. Treat the existence, exact mechanics, and required materials as unconfirmed until seen elsewhere. This source is already flagged elsewhere in this guide as one whose single-sourced terms should be treated cautiously.

Beginner priority

Beginner priority: if this system exists as described, it removes the fear of "wasting" enhancement investment when upgrading to a better base item. Until corroborated, don't plan your enhancement spending around the assumption that progress definitely transfers.
blocks.tags: transfer crafting gear upgrade soul binding carry over

blocks.title: Legion: Rank Structure and the Warehouse/Buff Controversy
blocks.titleEn: Legion: Rank Structure and the Warehouse/Buff Controversy
blocks.headExtrasHtml: Contested Legion perks contested
blocks.bodyHtml:
Three independent sources say Legions have no warehouse, buffs, or levels, contradicting several community guides.

What it is

Newly confirmed: Legions have a Legion Master and an officer corps; only an officer can rent the Legion hideout, at 1,000,000 Kinah for 23 days and 15 hours, matching the 1,000,000 Kinah rent figure in the Legion card above and adding the exact duration guildmanager.app, date unknown1.

The same source states it is explicitly not confirmed how many rank tiers exist, whether rank names can be customized, or what a full permission matrix contains, despite some guides presenting specific rank ladders as fact.

How it works

  • That source states plainly that Legions have "no levels, no buffs, no crafting, no rankings, no warehouse." guildmanager.app, date unknown2
    • Attributed to NCSoft developers.
    • It calls out that guides describing Legion warehouses, buffs, and Legion-unlocked Fortress Sieges draw on "an AI-generated page" that invented those features, citing a developer denial dated February 2026.
  • A second, independent source agrees: AION 2's developers "have publicly discussed Legions as intentionally limited." BoostRoom, date unknown3
    • No heavy Legion leveling or special buff trees as a core requirement.
    • It explicitly lists Legion levels, warehouses, stat buffs, and crafting bonuses as absent.
  • A third source repeats the no-warehouse claim, also attributed to NCSoft developer commentary without a direct quote or link guildmanager.app, date unknown4

Beginner priority

Beginner priority: don't join a Legion expecting a warehouse, guild-wide buffs, or a leveling structure that unlocks more perks over time. Do still join one for the confirmed, undisputed benefits: coordinated scheduling, reliable groups, and the hideout itself once an officer rents it.

Watch out

Direct conflict: the Legion card above states, from a single boosting-adjacent source, that "Legion Hall unlocks at Legion level 5," houses five crafting professions' stations, and that "Legion levels beyond 5 raise the member cap and unlock member access to purchase or use new Abyss weapons and armor." Three independent sources dispute Legion levels, warehouses, and mechanical buffs entirely, and one names "an AI-generated page" as the likely origin of exactly this kind of fabricated claim. Treat the Legion Hall level-5, crafting-unlock and Legion-Coin claims as contested rather than confirmed.
Avoid: picking a Legion based on advertised "Legion level" or "Legion buffs" claims that may not exist in the shipped game.
blocks.tags: legion guild ranks officer warehouse buffs contested

blocks.title: PvP Ranking Tiers and Season Leaderboards
blocks.titleEn: PvP Ranking Tiers and Season Leaderboards
blocks.headExtrasHtml: 20-tier seasonal ladder, KR/TW server data single source kr-era
blocks.bodyHtml:
A 20-tier seasonal PvP ladder sits on top of Abyss Points; the gap between low and top tiers is enormous, don't chase rank casually.

What it is

A seasonal ranking ladder layers on top of the Abyss Points system described in the Dungeons section.

One fan database documents 20 tiers for a completed KR/TW season, from Trainee (unranked) up through Ninth- through First-Class Soldier, One-Star through Five-Star Officer, General, Marshal, Commander, and a single Supreme Commander slot for the server's top player aion2hub, date unknown1.

How it works

  • Concrete point thresholds: Ninth-Class Soldier requires 3,000 ranking points, while the single Supreme Commander slot requires 25,000,000 aion2hub, date unknown2
  • Tiered rewards are listed as titles, statues, pets, coins, and class-specific gear varying by rank and class; the exact reward table per tier was not found
  • A separate, related page tracks Abyss race-ranking rewards for holding Artifacts and topping Abyss world-boss damage/participation, distinct from the general season ladder aion2hub, date unknown3
  • The Titles card notes titles come partly "via PvP rank, Arena tiers."
    • It doesn't describe the ladder itself.
    • The Dungeons page covers the Abyss zone, Arenas, and the contested status of Fortress Sieges as activities, but not this seasonal structure.
  • One source describes the Abyss zone as "the central inter-server Abyss battleground," implying cross-server matchmaking or population-sharing, not independently corroborated single source u4n, date unknown4
  • Two unverified third-party live-tracking tools exist for current standings: Shugo.gg5 and AionFlex6, neither an official source

Beginner priority

Beginner priority: don't chase rank early. The point gap between low and top tiers (3,000 vs 25,000,000) is enormous and clearly meant for dedicated, server-leading PvP players; casual PvP for gear and Abyss Points doesn't require caring about season rank at all.
blocks.tags: pvp ranking season leaderboard abyss rank tiers arena

blocks.title: Pet Power: Genus Insight and the Possession Effect
blocks.titleEn: Pet Power: Genus Insight and the Possession Effect
blocks.headExtrasHtml: Companion to the Pets and Mounts card single source
blocks.bodyHtml:
Leveling pets passively raises your Combat Power through a "Genus Insight" possession effect, not just acquisition and riding.

What it is

The Pets and Mounts card covers how to obtain pets (farming 10 souls per monster) but not what leveling them does for combat power.

How it works

Leveling and collecting pets contributes passive Combat Power through a mechanic described as "Pet Genus Insight" and a "possession effect," where raising a pet's level increases the effect and, in turn, the owner's Combat Power Vortex Gaming, date unknown1 Vortex Gaming, date unknown2.

  • Some individual pets carry unique active-use combat abilities, for example a "Fire Spirit Pup" with a fire attack skill effective against mid-level mobs.
Both sources trace to the same site, so treat this as effectively single-source despite being split across two articles. The Genus Insight/possession-effect terminology is not corroborated elsewhere.

Beginner priority

Beginner priority: this reinforces the Pets and Mounts card's advice to not ignore world mobs while leveling, pet collection has a passive Combat Power payoff on top of mount-riding convenience.

Watch out

Avoid: treating pets as purely cosmetic collectibles and skipping soul farming once you have a mount you like.
blocks.tags: pets combat power genus insight possession effect addendum

blocks.title: Odella and the Odyle Energy Naming Question
blocks.titleEn: Odella and the Odyle Energy Naming Question
blocks.headExtrasHtml: Endgame-oriented gathering material single source contested naming kr-era
blocks.bodyHtml:
Odella is likely the same resource this guide already calls Odyle Energy, but no source confirms the two names are identical.

What it is

Odella is a high-tier gathering material, obtained from gathering nodes and defeating an "Inder Boss" encountered while gathering, at roughly 6 Odella per gathering session Vortex Gaming, date unknown1.

How it works

The same source states Odella is used to craft "Odella Energy," a Daevanion Crystal-equivalent material, higher-tier wings, and other equipment, with a related crafting process resetting weekly (Wednesday 5 AM per the source), capping players at 7 crafts per week.

Naming flag: the Transcendence/Odyle Energy card and Currencies table both use "Odyle Energy" (also seen as "Grace of Odyle") for the resource spent to open dungeon reward cubes, sourced from a dated AION2Hub patch-notes translation. "Odella Energy," independently described as crafted from the Odella gathering material, is very likely the same underlying KR-language resource under a different fan transliteration, since both are consistently tied to dungeon/endgame progression, but no source explicitly states the two names refer to the same currency. contested, unconfirmed whether Odella Energy = Odyle Energy

Beginner priority

Beginner priority: if you see "Odella" in a KR-era guide and "Odyle Energy" elsewhere in this compendium, don't assume they're unrelated systems, they're most likely translation variants of the same mechanic, but don't assume they're definitely identical either until an official global glossary exists.
blocks.tags: odella odyle energy gathering material naming
